positions: 64 unique integer positions from linspace(0, P-1, 64), all ten timesteps and all 384 hidden outputs
basis: Leading right singular vectors of the frozen FC1 W, independent of selected source positions. No fine-tuning.
whole_domain_statistics: Reuse prior stage0 exact integer source cooccurrence matrix; recompute only its contraction with frozen W, theta and BN. Crosscheck all diagonal counts and predetermined 17 off-diagonal pairs against current verified source capture. No repeat of full-domain output forward.
certificate: With L=A X, E=W-(WQ)Q^T and L_perp=L-(LQ)Q^T, use ||L_perp||*||E_h|| + ||LQ||*||Q^T E_h||. Second term handles nonzero orthogonality defect. Hardware norm route is local T-by-T Gram and reduced LQ; explicit L is an evaluation oracle only.
metrics: norm and source Gram costs kept separate
scope: Float64 proxy opportunity, not rigorous rounded hardware certificate, not original FP32 equivalence. Additional exact-rational coordinate-projection examples check the abstract certificate with nonunit theta and signed full-rank A. No RTL, PPA, AEE, or speedup.
